verdict.rationale: Docs cover the full server-side flow: create a session via POST /v1/sessions, embed/redirect using web/native SDKs or hosted InContext flow, and read results via decision webhook or GET /v1/sessions/{id}/decision, with test integrations for dev. Biometric liveness (selfie) is explicitly available via API, web flow, and SDKs, confirming document+selfie capture without building custom capture UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no explicit end-to-end code sample tying session creation to redirect/embed to result-reading in one place.
